lci.text: The Mycotyrant began as a fungal outbreak at Topizielo that spread through the caverns and gave rise to the mycoids, so the Oltec sealed the Core off from the world while under siege from it.

When Malcolm Lee and Breeches reach it, the Mycotyrant declares that it has incorporated Malcolm's companions and Downtown's residents into its colony, and it says it wants everything, including the sun above.
It vows to assimilate them and ascend to the surface, but Malcolm's song stuns the colony and lets the pair escape, though its forces then erupt after them.
The Oltec fight it off in the Core while Breeches explodes its nexus, but the Mycotyrant survives, takes over Sunray Bay and sails for High and Dry in a new body.
